title: staggered-cutover-orbit-with-preview-sandboxes-and-telemetry-hedges
author: Asha Menon
description:
Motivation: teams running staged promotes and shadow-to-canary workflows need a way to safely preview a staged cutover in an isolated sandbox, deterministically replay captured traffic for validation, and anchor automated promotion/rollback decisions to a small set of telemetry hedges. This PR implements a new orchestration primitive — the Staggered Cutover Orbit — which composes preview sandboxes, holdpoint anchors, and replayable traffic snapshots into a resumable cutover flow.

What this change includes: - Preview sandboxes: ephemeral shadow lanes that run on isolated capacity and collect deterministic request traces and KV-state snapshots. Sandboxes are limited-scope and opt-in, used for smoke and functional validation before canary promotion. - Holdpoint anchors: declarative checkpoints that can be configured as automated (synthetic-smoke pass/fail) or manual (human approval). Holdpoints block the next phase of traffic promotion until satisfied. - Replayable snapshots: a compact capture format for requests and internal context that enables deterministic replay inside preview sandboxes and can be used during rollbacks to reproduce failures. - Telemetry hedges: a lightweight set of metrics (latency P95, error-rate, token-penalty, semantic-regression-score) combined into a scoring policy used by the orchestrator to recommend auto-rollforward or auto-backout. Policy is pluggable and integrates with Console dashboards. - UX/ops: Console UI annotations for sandboxes and holdpoints, an operator CLI to resume/pause cutovers, and a playbook in docs with runbooks for common failure modes.

Design notes: The orchestrator is deliberately conservative by default: preview sandboxes run with 0% production traffic and a bounded synthetic load. When a sandbox passes synthetic-smoke, the controller optionally seeds a canary with a small fraction of production traffic while continuing to run the sandbox in shadow mode. Snapshots are stored as compressed protobuf sequences in the model-registry bucket with versioned keys so replay is deterministic across model variants. Telemetry hedges are computed at the per-cohort level and emitted as tagged metrics; the controller uses a sliding-window aggregator with decay so transient spikes do not trigger immediate rollbacks.

Compatibility and migration: Existing rollout specs are backward-compatible. New fields under rollout.spec.preview and rollout.spec.holdpoints are additive. Operators running older controllers will ignore new fields. Migration job included to backfill default hedges for recent deployments.

Checklist: - [x] Controller implementation and unit tests - [x] Integration test for deterministic replay in preview sandbox - [x] Console annotations and CLI helpers - [x] Migration job and safety-guarding feature flag - [x] Docs + runbook - [x] Perf microbenchmarks (latency overhead for shadowing < 2%)

Risks and mitigations: replay snapshots can be large for heavy workloads; we use sampling and size caps and include a TTL. Sandboxed replays can diverge because of non-deterministic side effects — replay recommends read-only smoke inputs by default and flags stateful replays for manual review. Telemetry hedges are conservative and require multiple windows to cross thresholds.

Related work: references to ENG-2987 (cohort anchoring), PRs that added shadow capture plumbing, and PM-902 (product spec for preview lanes).

Release notes: Adds Staggered Cutover Orbit: preview sandboxes, holdpoint anchors, replayable snapshots, and telemetry hedges for safer staged promotions. Feature gated by rollout.preview.enabled and rollout.telemetry.hedges.

review_comments: Diego Alvarez (2026-01-18): Overall looks strong. Two requests: (1) make snapshot keys deterministic across variants (so replays can target specific model vips); (2) lower default sample rate for snapshots to 0.05 for high-throughput customers. Can you add a lightweight size-estimate metric on the snapshot path?

Asha Menon (2026-01-19): Addressed both asks. Snapshot keys now include model-version digest and cohort-id. Added snapshot.size_est_bytes metric and default sample rate changed to 5%. Updated migration to set sample_rate on existing rollout specs. PTAL.

Priya Sharma (2026-01-22): CI flagged a lint error in telemetry/hedges.go; also suggest turning the hedges policy into a plugin interface so teams can provide custom scoring. Could we expose an adapter interface?
Asha Menon (2026-01-23): Converted hedges evaluator to an interface and added a default builtin implementation. Fixed lint and added tests for a mock plugin. CI re-run requested.

Evan Chen (2026-01-28): Integration tests look good. One nit: reduce default shadow concurrency for sandboxes to avoid noisy autoscaling at small accounts. Also please add a short perf note in the runbook about expected memory usage for replay buffers.
Asha Menon (2026-01-29): Reduced default sandbox concurrency to 2 and added perf section in runbook. Thanks!
